#Power Cell Example
Power.Cell <- read.csv("/cloud/project/Data/Power Cell.csv")
head(Power.Cell)
#remove any variables matching Power Cell variables before attaching the variables
rm(X1, X2, Y)
attach(Power.Cell)

#Without centering the variables
f2<-lm(Y~X1+I(X1^2)+X2+I(X2^2),data=Power.Cell)
summary(f2)
library(faraway)
vif(f2)

#using the build in functions
#raw=TRUE, centerting th variables as bove
#raw=False. This is based on orthogonal polynomials:
#Z_{1}= a_{1} + b_{1}X 
#Z_{2}= a_{2} + b_{2}X + c_{2}X^{2}
#Z_{3}= a_{3} + b_{3}X + c_{3}X^{2}+ d_{3}X^{3}
#raw=FALSE, will give you different answers
#it will give you the same response
Polyfit2a <- lm(Y ~ poly(X1, 2, raw=TRUE)+poly(X2, 2, raw=TRUE))
summary(Polyfit2a)

rbind(Polyfit2a$coefficients,f2$coefficients)

#Centering the variables
x1<-(X1-mean(X1)) 
x2<-(X2-mean(X2)) 
x1sqr<-x1^2
x2sqr<-x2^2  
x1x2<-x1*x2
f<-lm(Y~ x1+ x2+ x1sqr+ x2sqr)
summary(f)
vif(f)

#with interaction term
f1<-lm(Y~ x1+ x2+ x1sqr+ x2sqr+x1x2)
summary(f1)
vif(f1)

#can we drop the quadratic and interaction terms
#Ho: B3=B4=B5=0
#Ha: not equal to zero
f2<-lm(Y~ x1+ x2)
summary(f2)
anova(f2,f1)

#Ho:Terms can be dropped vs. Ha: Terms cannot be dropped
#pvalue is 0.55, terms can be dropped from the model
